mapper.select: SELECT path FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE source_id = #{sourceId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE source_id = #{sourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_document (id, source_id, path, title, checksum, size_bytes, chunk_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sourceId}, #{path}, #{title}, #{checksum}, #{sizeBytes}, #{chunkCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET title = #{title}, checksum = #{checksum}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND path = #{path}
